description: Depth cut arm (a), 2/3/3. Base: E116 code. Remove group-1 conv3 (with its BN and GELU) so group 1 is conv1 plus a single-conv residual branch. Re-batch the Muon filter stacks for the changed counts, including the frozen-group-1 update variant. Rebuild the dirac init over the remaining convs. Warm every (resolution, batch) x freeze x renorm x whiten-bias-grad variant in build, and check on a 2-trial dev run with TORCH_LOGS=recompiles that nothing compiles after build. Change nothing else: schedule, 85% freeze, tail. Before deciding, run an untimed per-step profile of the modified net at all four shapes (with the frozen 32 px variant) and project total time over the E116 schedule, because E123's -7.6% was measured with the freeze off. Accuracy is decided untimed on seeds 3-102 in one fresh process against the pooled ~198-trajectory E116 baseline. Score once only if the loss is <= 0.35 pp.
